proof_attempt_summary: Discovery passed at field tier, and formalization repaired the censor-law encoding, fold-map and endpoint-cell interfaces, built reusable iid-DQM/LAN and convolution infrastructure, and closed the Wald measurability gap without adding a theorem premise. The run failed at the paper-specific primitive endpoint concentration chain: its additive boundary approximation cannot represent mixed cubic terms, while the concentration helper contains no probability event or Gram/inverse/noise control. A retry must replace that helper with the full ten-term mixed cubic basis and develop the associated coercivity, Bernstein, union-bound, clipping, and measurability theory before downstream headline proofs can be discharged.
tldr: In a designed-depletion or calibrated loss-to-follow-up regime, the censoring time is the earlier of two conditionally independent continuous loss or availability times whose near-horizon survivals vanish linearly, giving the known quadratic endpoint order while leaving the smooth residual censoring law unknown. At the scientific horizon, this quadratic censoring makes the influence function for survival itself non-square-integrable, but the remaining-life factor in fixed-endpoint RMST cancels one endpoint power and leaves a finite efficiency bound. The paper constructs a total cross-fitted one-step estimator with a uniform expansion over the stated radius-20 H\"older primitive class while learning the treatment propensity, event hazard, and rescaled censoring residual. At every interior law, normalized smooth censoring-density tilts preserve the exact quadratic factor, all finite smooth generating submodels are differentiable in quadratic mean and hence locally asymptotically normal, and compactness plus observed-law identifiability extend estimator regularity to every relevant in-class DQM local alternative. Simultaneous local-cubic concentration in the last time--covariate cells gives nuisance rate \( (\log n/n)^{1/3} \), and a terminal-strip Fano packing proves a matching minimax sup-norm lower bound for learning the event hazard over the same primitive class. This sharp primitive rate, exact product drift, weak \(5/2\)-moment Studentization, full endpoint-efficiency certificate, and uniform Wald coverage form the publishable kernel.
gap: Westling et al. establish machine-learning inference for treatment-specific survival and integrated RMST under a censoring floor and high-level nuisance-rate conditions. Classical endpoint Kaplan--Meier theory permits vanishing follow-up for integrated functionals but has no conditional confounding adjustment or learned nuisance blocks. Existing local-polynomial hazard theory does not supply uniform last-cell concentration when the predictable risk set collapses quadratically.
